decision.reason: [ev-fe02a4220985] says only that the Venafi client can now use a custom client ID with username/password authentication. It does not say where that setting lives, so the subject can't be named: no Issuer/ClusterIssuer field path, Secret key, flag or Helm value is given, and neither is the default client ID. Without that configuration surface, no applicability condition can be written. None of the other items in the Feature section mentions Venafi. PR #7484 is only referenced, not shown, so its contents (the field or key name) are needed to settle the subject and applicability.
